label: Image scan (recognition)
description: An image under recognition: corner brackets draw in, a small 'Researching' chip sits top-left with its spark turning, and the image swaps to the next one on a beat -- 'Know what you're looking at', 'we read every creative', shown working. The card fills the component's box (a portrait box reads best beside a headline). Example: {"images":["...","...","..."],"label":"Researching","every":1.3}.

scan_at.label: When the brackets draw and the chip shows (default at + 0.45)

chip_size.label: Chip text size as a fraction of the card width (default 0.038)
